title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms a categorical variable into a binary matrix. Each category is represented by a column, and a row has a '1' in the column corresponding to its category and '0' elsewhere.

title: Adding an Intercept Term
text: When adding an intercept term to a design matrix, you add a column of ones. This column does not affect the rank of the matrix if the other columns are linearly independent.

title: Understanding Matrix Rank
text: The rank of a matrix is the maximum number of linearly independent column vectors in the matrix. It is also the dimension of the column space.
